AuthoredShop.description: A shop, as its operator authors it: where it is, what it sells at what price, and who keeps it.

at.description: The place the shop is in: a place key.

keepers.description: The people who may list, re-price and withdraw the shop's goods while standing in it: person keys, each once, at most 8. Without keepers the shop keeps its opening prices.

prices.description: What it sells: an item key, then its asking price in minor units, 1 to 10^12. These are the organization's asks.

EntityKey.description: An authoring key: the name of a file in people/, places/, items/ or organizations/ without .yaml. 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits, - and _, not starting or ending with - or _.

description: Money and selling: what this person or organization has when the world begins and what it offers for sale, or what this item kind is typically worth.

asks.description: What this person offers to sell, for itself: an item key, then its asking price, 1 to 10^12. Only a person; an organization sells through its shop's `prices`.

reference.description: This item kind's typical worth, 1 to 10^12: never charged, used for wealth and as a pricing default. Only on an item's file, and then nothing else.

shop.description: The shop this holder runs. Only an organization runs one; on a person's file it is refused.

wallet.description: The money held when the world begins, in minor units of the world's currency (with two decimal places, 2000 is 20.00). Required on a person or an organization; never on an item.
